goal.insight: Present a multi-indicator comparison across 10 countries to visually reveal which regions face the most severe convergence of water stress indicators
Emphasize the wide disparity in water supply-to-demand ratios across the 10 countries, highlighting those where demand exceeds or nearly exceeds supply
Visually distinguish countries with the highest groundwater extraction rates relative to recharge, making unsustainable extraction patterns prominent
Show the decadal precipitation trend (increasing vs decreasing) alongside the other water stress metrics so viewers can see which water-scarce countries also face declining rainfall
Contrast per-capita freshwater availability between water-rich and water-poor nations to make the orders-of-magnitude difference visually striking
